text: Guys, today I want to talk about men's main rules, the principles you should follow if you want to live a good life as a man. And probably the most important rule out there is this. I want, I act, I get the result. Step 1. I want. Sounds obvious, but a lot of men don't even admit what they want. Do you want a girlfriend? Date? Intimacy? Respect? A better body? More money? Probably you do. But many guys pretend that they don't care, or it's not that important. Just admitting the desire would also mean they don't have it yet. That hurts their ego and that puts them out of their comfort zone. But if you can't say it honestly, you'll never move. So the first job is clarity and honesty with yourself. If you like a girl, you like her. If you want a better life, you want it. Because if you can't honestly say what you want, how would you move towards it? Step 2. I act. This is where many men struggle. Even if they know what they want, they wait, they overthink, they look for motivation, they hope for the perfect moment. But the rule is simple. Ask yourself, what do I need to do to get what I want? And then do it. If you want dates, you approach, you text, you set plans. If you want a better body, you train and watch your diet. If you want money, you learn skills, work harder, and take risks. The world doesn't reward intentions, it rewards actions. Motivation and confidence come later. Step 3. I get the result. Not immediately. Sometimes the first result is rejection, failure, or embarrassment. And that is fine. Results are feedback. Every man who gets something had to survive a phase where he got nothing. The difference is simple. He kept acting. And here's the brutal truth. If you don't like what you're getting in life, don't blame luck, women, society, or your past. Look at what you are doing. Because results never lie. So remember the men's main rule number one and use it in your life. I want. I act. I get the result.
